description: Check if a domain is associated with disposable or temporary email services. Returns risk assessment, a 0-100 confidence score and the signals behind it. Pass your own Disify key as _apiKey — the keyless anonymous quota is shared and usually spent.

_apiKey.description: Optional but recommended: your own Disify API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Without it the call uses the anonymous tier, whose daily quota is shared across all Pipeworx callers and is usually exhausted. Get one at disify.com.

domain.description: The domain name to check, e.g. "mailinator.com".

name: check_domain

disposable.description: Whether the domain is associated with disposable email services

dns_valid.description: Whether DNS records exist for the domain

title: Check Domain
